name: enneo-codex
description: Connect Codex to Enneo platform instances for ticket investigation, AI agent development, and platform administration.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Enneo instances directly from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Enneo Codex connects Codex to Enneo customer-service instances. It bundles native MCP tools for setup, profile verification, and ticket investigation, plus Codex skills for tickets, AI agents, customers, events, knowledge, reports, settings, telephony, templates, tags, users, tools, and troubleshooting via the Enneo REST API.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Enneo instance and show my profile.
Search recent open tickets in Enneo.
Investigate why an Enneo AI agent skipped a ticket.
